priorities.heading: Lowering Costs & Growing the Economy
priorities.quote: Make life more affordable by cutting wasteful spending, lowering inflation, and creating an economy where small businesses can grow and create good-paying jobs.

priorities.heading: Healthcare
priorities.quote: Lower prescription drug costs by increasing transparency and holding pharmacy benefit managers accountable.

priorities.heading: Agriculture & Rural Iowa
priorities.quote: Protect family farms by pushing back against burdensome regulations, improving voluntary conservation programs, and fighting policies like California’s Proposition 12 that hurt Iowa family farmers.

housing.heading: Lowering Costs & Growing the Economy
housing.quote: Help more families become homeowners by allowing first-time homebuyers to save tax-free for a down payment through the First Home Savings Opportunity Act and ensuring large institutional investors cannot buy up single-family homes in Iowa neighborhoods.

immigration.heading: Border Security & Public Safety
immigration.quote: Secure the southern border by enforcing America’s immigration laws and deporting dangerous criminal illegal immigrants.

foreign-policy.heading: Protecting Iowa Values
foreign-policy.quote: Hold Communist China accountable for ripping off American jobs and innovation, purchasing American farmland, and implementing unfair trade practices that hurt Iowa farmers, workers, and businesses.

climate-energy.heading: Agriculture & Rural Iowa
climate-energy.quote: Keep Iowa at the forefront of American energy by championing year-round E15, strengthening biofuels, and investing in homegrown energy production.

priorities.heading: Restoring political power to the people
priorities.quote: I will also sponsor legislation to eliminate the corrupting role of PACs and super PACs in our electoral system.

priorities.heading: Ending eminent domain abuse
priorities.quote: As a U.S. Senator, I will work to pass legislation prohibiting private companies from harnessing the coercive power of the state to seize property for commercial gain, ending eminent domain abuse in our nation.

priorities.heading: Stopping wasteful wars
priorities.quote: As a U.S. Senator, I will fight to bring our men and women in uniform home, to block foolish wars declared by presidents without the consent of Congress, and to conserve our nation’s military strength for those rare occasions when our nation’s vital interests are truly at stake.
